summary:
ASTRA (Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer) is an interactive, browser-based space survival and learning game designed to teach children aged 7–12 about the challenges of living on the Moon and Mars.

Players take command of a space research outpost and must keep their crew alive for 30 days by managing essential resources such as oxygen, water, food, electricity, radiation protection, and crew health.

The project integrates real NASA resources, including space weather observations, Mars rover photographs, and space biology research. Players encounter realistic space-related challenges, make critical decisions, and learn scientific concepts through interactive missions and scenarios.

ASTRA also features ASTRA AI, an educational mission advisor that provides contextual hints and scientific explanations without making decisions for players.

By combining NASA data, simulation, and interactive learning, ASTRA makes space exploration more accessible, engaging, and educational for the next generation of explorers.
details:
ASTRA – Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive educational space exploration simulator that allows players to experience the challenges of maintaining a human research outpost on the Moon or Mars.

HOW IT WORKS:

Players select a planet, configure their astronaut profile, and begin a 30-day survival mission. During the mission, they manage six essential parameters: oxygen, water, food, electricity, radiation protection, and crew health.

Players can perform different activities, including generating oxygen, recycling water, growing food, cleaning solar panels, strengthening radiation shields, conducting scientific experiments, and resting the crew.

The game includes 15 interactive scenarios with three possible choices, each carrying different costs, consequences, and scientific lessons. Emergency situations such as solar storms, water shortages, power failures, and oxygen shortages challenge players to make strategic decisions.

NASA DATA INTEGRATION:

ASTRA integrates NASA's DONKI Space Weather Database, Mars Rover Photos API, and Open Science Data Repository (OSDR). These resources provide real-world space weather observations, Mars rover imagery, and access to space biology research.

The application clearly distinguishes actual NASA observations from simulated gameplay values to maintain scientific accuracy.

AI-POWERED LEARNING:

ASTRA AI is an offline, rule-based educational assistant that explains scientific concepts, provides mission hints, and helps players understand the consequences of their decisions without choosing on their behalf.

TECHNOLOGY USED:

  • Frontend: React 18 and JavaScript
  • Build Tool: Vite
  • Styling: Tailwind CSS
  • Animations: Framer Motion
  • Charts: Recharts
  • Icons: Lucide React
  • Navigation: React Router
  • Data Integration: NASA Open APIs and NASA OSDR
  • Backend: Vercel Serverless Functions
  • Storage: Browser LocalStorage

IMPACT AND INNOVATION:

ASTRA transforms complex space science concepts into an interactive learning experience. It encourages scientific curiosity, critical thinking, resource management, problem-solving, and decision-making.

The project aims to inspire young learners to understand the challenges of future human space exploration and develop an interest in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM).
